api.openapi_spec_url: https://developer.buildium.com/ (OpenAPI served inside the Redoc page; direct spec URL not confirmed)

scopes_needed_read: API key permissions are set per key by the customer admin when creating the key (exact permission list UNVERIFIED)
auth.token_lifetime: no token; client ID and secret sent on every request

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: None required for direct API-key use. Buildium docs describe the API as customer-key based.
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Per Propexo's Buildium guide (secondary, matches Buildium help): admin user on a Premium subscription turns on Settings > Application settings > System preferences > API settings > Open API toggle, then Settings > Developer Tools > Create API Key, names it, and copies the client ID and secret to us.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: $0 (customer needs Buildium Premium plan per secondary sources)

sandbox.how_to_get: Buildium FAQ in developer.buildium.com mentions a sandbox account (limited to 10 concurrent requests per second; reset not supported). How to obtain: UNVERIFIED.

rate_limits: 'we limit clients to 10 concurrent requests per second'; 429 returned on violation (developer.buildium.com).
incremental_sync: LastUpdatedFrom / LastUpdatedTo filters on several resources including general ledger transactions and applicants (changelog in developer.buildium.com); not confirmed for every resource.
blockers: Customer must be on a Premium plan with Open API enabled by an admin (secondary source; confirm on Buildium help center)
sources: https://developer.buildium.com/ - 'x-buildium-client-id' and 'x-buildium-client-secret' request headers; 'we limit clients to 10 concurrent requests per second'; server https://api.buildium.com/
https://developer.buildium.com/ changelog - 'General ledger transaction resources can now be filtered by LastUpdatedFrom and LastUpdatedTo'
